subject: Demo recap & proposed 4-week validation playbook
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cedarpoint.ai>, Priyanka Rao <pri@cedarpoint.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed 4-week validation playbook

Hi Sanjay / Priyanka —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. I pulled together a short, practical validation playbook so your data science and infra teams can run a focused evaluation over four weeks. High level: the goal is to validate fit for your triage/summary workload and confirm latency/cost targets so you can decide on a production rollout.

Attached: Redwood_4wk_validation_playbook.pdf (detailed week-by-week runbook) and MVP_metrics_template.xlsx (example dashboard metrics). I also uploaded the recording to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-redwood/cedarpoint-poc

Key success criteria (proposal) — please review and flag changes:
- Functional: >= 85% summary relevance on your blind eval set (per your QA labels)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 450ms for the 512-token average prompt (on a single model variant)
- Cost: per-inference cost < $0.015 at projected batch size (with recommended batching profile)
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 1k requests/day sustained window

Proposed 4-week cadence (high level):
Week 0 (kickoff): access, config, sample data ingest, finalize eval set and metrics
Week 1: baseline runs with default model, collect token/latency profiles
Week 2: iteration — quantization/throughput tuning, KV prefix cache validation
Week 3: SLA stress + A/B run of model variant (low-cost vs low-latency)
Week 4: acceptance review, final metrics, decision meeting

Who does what (owners):
- CedarPoint: provide blinded eval set, list of key intents for acceptance, and a staging endpoint
- Redwood (Aditya): provision trial cluster, provide API keys, and run initial tuning
- Redwood (Michael): PM for the engagement, coordinate stakeholders and decision review
- CedarPoint (Sanjay): coordinate infra access and sign-off on SLA targets

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Kickoff 30–45m call to align on eval set and start date — options: Mon 9/20 or Tue 9/21 (your timezone)
2) I’ll drop a short access pack (API keys, sample curl examples, minimal onboarding notes) once you confirm kickoff
3) Please send any hard constraints we should bake into success criteria (e.g., regulatory, retention, or network restrictions)

If that looks good I’ll lock in the kickoff and have Aditya provision a trial cluster ahead of time.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed 4-week validation playbook

Michael — thanks for the concise plan and the docs. Quick notes from our side after a fast sync with infra/ML:  
- The functional target is fine but can we make the metric relative to our existing summarizer (so we set a delta, e.g., +10% F1 vs current model)?
- Latency: the 95th percentile target is helpful, but we need a hard constraint at 99th percentile as well (we can’t exceed 900ms on peak windows) — can Redwood run a 99th percentile check in Week 3 stress runs?
- Start date: Tue 9/21 works better for us (we’ll be back from travel on the 20th). Kickoff at 10am PT would be ideal.

Also, we’ll need a short security checklist before any keys are issued (SOC2 attachments or pointer to your compliance package). Priyanka will start that questionnaire.

Thanks — Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | CedarPoint Analytics
sanjay@cedarpoint.ai

- 99th percentile latency: we’ll add a 99th check during Week 3 stress testing and capture both pre- and post-optimization numbers.
- Security checklist: attaching a link to our compliance pack (SOC 2 summary + contact for detailed evidence). If you prefer a DocuSign workflow for the questionnaire let me know.

I’ll lock kickoff for Tue 2026-09-21 10:00am PT and will send a calendar invite shortly. If you hit any policy gating, loop Laura in.

Michael
